programme.title: I was the king – Grzegorz Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Grzegorz Lato won the top scorer's crown twice in the colors of Stal Mielec in the then 1st league, in 1973 and 1975. He was also the top scorer in the 1974 World Cup. After finishing his football career, he became a coach and later the president of the Polish Football Association (2008-2012). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Cuba: A trip to the Caribbean | E01
programme.desc: Colin Stafford Johnson takes viewers back to a time just 50 years ago when Earth's wildlife seemed abundant. It is a journey into a world that may soon disappear forever. The expedition begins in the south of the island in the Zapata Swamp. The largest single protected area in the entire Caribbean is home to the world's smallest bird, the bee hummingbird. Decades of a conservation-minded socialist government, US embargoes and minimal development have left the region largely unchanged for five decades. Regardless of politics, Cuba's isolation has created a natural citadel in the Caribbean. Forests cover large areas of the island, and its waters contain some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Half of Cuba's flora and fauna are found only here - from the local species of crocodiles and snakes to the smallest birds and frogs on the planet. Colin Stafford Johnson begins his expedition in the swamps of the Zapata Peninsula. Cuba's isolation means that there are places that have remained unchanged for decades, and the coral reef is one of the richest in the world. Austria. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: 30 for 30: I'm Just Here for the Riot
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: An X-ray survey of the Earth's surface revealed a huge anomaly 80 miles off the northwest Pacific coast. For more than 300 years, the pressure in this anomaly has been gradually increasing. If it reaches certain levels, it could cause a mega-earthquake and accompanying tsunami that could devastate a region called Cascadia, home to almost 15 million people. Scientists are racing to predict how bad the destruction will be when this Big Bang occurs. Dir.: Ian A. Hunt, Nick Tanner. USA

programme.title: d/s Earth under X-ray (Apocalypse: Volcanoes)

programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Saudo Arabija. Год: 2017. S1, Ep5 «Rooted»…Located on the Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe, this 800-year-old baobab is a remarkable tree containing its own ecosystem. Capable of withstanding extreme drought by storing water in its hollow trunk, it draws a multitude of wildlife, from elephants who strip its bark in search of food, to vultures that nest on its branches. Remarkably, it also has another gift: a velvety fruit packed with an astonishing cocktail of nutrients. To witness the baobab is to be awed by the natural forces that produced itDocumentary series examining the staggering wildlife activity on five of Africa's most iconic trees. Standing tall in often startlingly harsh environments, to survive as a tree in Africa requires much cunning. From the baobab's ability to store water, to the tricks of the sausage tree when seducing pollinators, this compelling series explores the thriving activity of each deeply rooted species, where birds, insects and other animals utilise their extraordinary featuresDirector: Dereck Joubert, Beverly JoubertCast: Fiona Ramsay

programme.title: Land Without Land (Sharks of the Fiji Archipelago)
programme.desc: Dive into an adrenaline-filled journey into the depths of the South Pacific. Meet Fiji's apex predator. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Poland

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 9 p.
programme.desc: Join charming and energetic Sydney veterinarian Chris Brown and his team as they treat animals in the Bondi Beach area with great care and professionalism. From rescuing pets to caring for wild animals, they face new challenges every day. Watch as they save lives and create miracles, bringing light and hope to the animal world. Australia

programme.title: Land Without Land (Whales: Kingdom of Tonga)
programme.desc: Join us on a journey across the ocean to follow humpback whales on their annual migration to the warm waters of Wawa. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Poland

programme.title: d/f Marine Mammals: Champions of the Deep
programme.desc: How do marine mammals overcome incredible depths and pressures that are inaccessible to humans? Why are whales able to hold their breath for tens of minutes, while dolphins navigate in complete darkness? In this film, French researchers reveal the secrets of the unique adaptations that allow these animals to be true champions of the deep. You'll see rare footage of underwater life, learn about complex social relationships and unusual hunting methods, and learn about the latest scientific discoveries that are changing our understanding of life in the ocean. France

programme.title: d/s Underwater China. 1 p.
programme.desc: We invite you on an exciting journey under the waters of China! The project opens up amazing underwater worlds to viewers, hidden from the eyes of most people. We explore unique ecosystems where rare species of fish, shellfish and other sea creatures live. You will see how the life of underwater inhabitants changes depending on the time of year and climatic conditions, and learn how local residents care about the preservation of these fragile ecosystems

programme.title: d/s Underwater China. 2 s.
programme.desc: We invite you on an exciting journey under the waters of China! The project opens up amazing underwater worlds to viewers, hidden from the eyes of most people. We explore unique ecosystems where rare species of fish, shellfish and other sea creatures live. You will see how the life of underwater inhabitants changes depending on the time of year and climatic conditions, and learn how local residents care about the preservation of these fragile ecosystems

programme.title: d/f Superdads of the wild
programme.desc: In the animal world, the role of the male in raising offspring is quite diverse. Most species are characterized by a model in which males do not take part in caring for the young and often are not even aware of their paternity. However, there are exceptions when males become real caring fathers, actively taking part in the upbringing of their offspring. France

programme.title: d/f Kingdom of the Little Owl
programme.desc: The little owl was an integral part of rural landscapes, but its population has declined sharply due to changes in agriculture and disturbances in natural habitats. The destruction of hedges, the replacement of old pollard willows with metal poles, the intensive use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides - all these factors have disrupted the ecosystem and brought the species to the brink of extinction

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 1 p.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. The heroes of the series are the most creative, aggressive and inquisitive representatives of the fauna, surprising with their instincts and habits. Australia

programme.title: d/f Beaver – superhero of the wild
programme.desc: Beavers turn out to be much more important to nature than they might seem. Their dams, canals and wetlands form new ecosystems, maintain water levels and help the environment adapt to climate change. The film shows how the work of these rodents can help preserve biodiversity and protect nature. USA

programme.title: d/f Morocco from a bird's eye view. 1 p.
programme.desc: A unique journey awaits you over Morocco, where every frame is a new discovery. Flying over the Atlas Mountains, you'll see snow-capped peaks before being transported into the heart of the Sahara Desert, where sand dunes give way to green oases. The cameras will show ancient cities, lively markets and ancient fortresses hidden from the eyes of ordinary tourists. Get to know the culture, traditions and nature of this amazing country without leaving your home. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand. France

programme.title: d/f Morocco from a bird's eye view. 2 s.
programme.desc: A unique journey awaits you over Morocco, where every frame is a new discovery. Flying over the Atlas Mountains, you'll see snow-capped peaks before being transported into the heart of the Sahara Desert, where sand dunes give way to green oases. The cameras will show ancient cities, lively markets and ancient fortresses hidden from the eyes of ordinary tourists. Get to know the culture, traditions and nature of this amazing country without leaving your home. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand. France

programme.title: d/s Thoughts of the wild. 1 p.
programme.desc: The documentary series will reveal the secrets of the animal world, allowing you to look at the world through the eyes of animals and birds. We will explore the nature of fear, the mechanism of telling time, and the mysterious sense of danger. How do animals perceive their environment? What lies behind their instincts and behavior? Together we will reveal the secrets of nature and see the world as the animals themselves see it. Spain

programme.title: d/s On the brink of extinction (Australia)
programme.desc: Every day, about 200 species of plants and animals leave the planet, accelerating the process of the sixth mass extinction. It is important to act to preserve biodiversity by protecting the natural centers of life that are located in different parts of the world. This project shows how life on Earth depends on the preservation of these ecosystems. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/f Journey of the Wolf
programme.desc: The incredible story of a wolf named Slava, which shocked the scientific community. His own pack rejected him and forced him to travel thousands of kilometers from the depths of the Romanian tundra to the shores of the Atlantic Ocean. During this difficult journey he will meet a female, and together they form a new pack. France

programme.title: d/f Hunters of the Mediterranean Sea
programme.desc: In the world of wildlife, every living creature is not just part of an ecosystem, but also a participant in a brutal struggle for survival. This documentary takes us into the hunting strategies of Europe's most dangerous predators, from wild wolves to majestic eagles. We will also see how victims of predators invent their own tactics to escape. Spain

programme.title: d/s Birds: masters of the elements (Element of earth)
programme.desc: Birds live in the harshest corners of the planet - from the crater of a volcano to the depths of the sea. The series reveals the unique connection between birds and the four natural elements: air, water, earth and fire. They can withstand winds, overcome oceans, and get food in extreme conditions. But along with nature, they also have to adapt to human influence - the fifth element that they are encountering more and more often. Spain

programme.title: d/f Queen of the North
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in the amazing world of the northern forests, where one of the most secretive and beautiful predators reigns. Observe her habits, hunting and struggle for survival in conditions of eternal winter. Discover how this graceful huntress became a symbol of endurance and strength, and why her presence is so important to the balance of the ecosystem. Mesmerizing footage and rare moments from the life of the northern lynx await you on this exciting journey. Spain

programme.title: film Wild Dogs. 1 p.
programme.desc: In Bucharest, where massive catches of stray dogs are taking place, the fates of several people intersect. Geordie, a pornographer from Canada, comes to Romania in search of subjects to work on, and an encounter with the locals forces him to reconsider his values. Bogdan, who works with homeless animals, is faced with a moral choice, and Natalie, the lonely wife of a diplomat, finds herself embroiled in the struggle for children, dogs and gypsies who find themselves on the margins of life. Canada

programme.title: d/f Coral oasis of the Tuamotu island
programme.desc: Tuamotu are the “distant islands” of Tahiti, lost in the middle of the ocean, far from the noisy world and trade routes. programme.title: The great parks in Africa
programme.desc: Table Mountain National Park is located on a rugged peninsula on the Atlantic Ocean. Surrounded by the sea and the metropolis, it impresses with its extraordinary biodiversity on the southwestern tip of Africa. (Station info).

programme.title: The great parks in Africa
programme.desc: iSimangaliso Wetland Park: Beaches, coral reefs, forests and lakes meet on the northeast coast of South Africa - a natural wonder that the locals call "The Miracle". (Station info).

programme.title: The African wildlife – life and survival
programme.desc: At 60 years old, an elephant is considered old. What has this pachyderm experienced? How did he defend his rank in the troops and, as always, find enough food in the dry season? (Station info).

programme.title: Chimpanzees in the Congo with Jane Goodall
programme.desc: Research at Tchimpounga station continues. Now the focus is on the intelligence of chimpanzees. The work of Dr. Goodall on the use of tools provides valuable tips. (Station info).

programme.title: Chimpanzees in the Congo with Jane Goodall
programme.desc: Rebecca rescued eight chimpanzees in Angola, who are now safe in the sanctuary. The release program for the mandrill monkeys has to be changed when a new animal is added. (Station info).

programme.title: Champions of the animal world
programme.desc: Extraordinary senses of the animal world: saltwater crocodiles sense even the smallest movements, pigeons navigate using an internal GPS, and dolphins locate their prey using echolocation. (Station info).

programme.title: Champions of the animal world
programme.desc: Komodo dragons kill with their bite, mongooses defy the poisons of their enemies, birds even counter deadly toxins - a look at nature's biological warfare. (Station info).

programme.title: Crazy but true!
programme.desc: Some animal encounters send shivers down your spine: an elephant attack becomes a race with death. Elsewhere, a sea lion “kidnaps” a little girl. (Station info).

programme.title: Crazy but true!
programme.desc: There are plenty of dangerous situations in the animal kingdom - a bear is looking for food outside its territory, a rat encounters a hungry cat. Conflicts often end differently than expected. (Station info).

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: The cold waters off Australia's southern coast are home to a unique diversity of species: around 70 percent of marine life occurs exclusively here. (Station info).

programme.title: The Atlantic: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: It's summer! The North Atlantic is finally reaching warm temperatures and food is plentiful. In short: the returned sharks and whales find perfect conditions for feeding. (Station info).

programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: The Rockys, the Andes, the Himalayas: mountain regions are the setting for the six-part BBC co-production this time. In hard-to-reach places, film crews lured residents into the camera trap: the Nubian ibex, a family of grizzlies and well-camouflaged snow leopards. “Terra X”.

programme.title: DIỄN VIÊN ĐÓNG THẾ VÕ THUẬT - KUNGFU STUNTMEN
programme.desc: Điện ảnh hành động Hồng Kông nổi tiếng với những chiêu thức kung fu chân thực được thực hiện bởi một nhóm có tên “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. Bộ phim tài liệu này nhằm tri ân các thế hệ diễn viên đóng thế kung fu, với đoàn làm phim đã dành hơn hai năm để đào bới các kho lưu trữ và phỏng vấn nhiều tài năng, bao gồm cả những bậc thầy nổi bật nhất như Thành Long, Chân Tử Đan và Hồng Kim Bảo.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: CUỘC CHIẾN TÀN KHỐC - CRUEL WAR
programme.desc: Để chống lại hiệu ứng nhà kính, nhà khoa học Yan Xin cố gắng trồng những hạt giống siêu cao su mới được phát triển trên một hòn đảo xa xôi với hy vọng biến nó thành một vùng đất mới thịnh vượng. Chồng cũ của Yan Xin quyết định đồng hành cùng cô trên hành trình đầy nguy hiểm này. Khi xung đột nảy sinh, họ chạm trán với băng đảng ma túy địa phương và một trận chiến sinh tử sắp bắt đầu.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS

Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.
